name: Marching Orders
body:
Using your capability as a commander, you urge your allies to make a coordinated movement.

Prerequisites: Leadership, Legendary Leader, Commanding Presence, Leadership score 15+

Benefit: As a standard action, you may expend a use of your Commanding Presence to give all allies within 30 feet a single move action. This move action must be taken immediately and can only be used for movement. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Instead of moving, an ally can also choose to use this movement to stand up from prone.

Standing still provokes an attack of opportunity.
